title: Matrix-driven GUI qualification and coverage evidence
summary: Local runner orchestrates multi-renderer test/coverage phases, preserves artifacts and distinguishes qualification from incomplete evidence collection.

dates.note: Exact project start/end dates remain unknown. Direct local source/history review on 2026-10-29 supplements the supplied October 5 snapshot and separately dated owner statements. Commit milestones and review dates are not project starts or release dates.

facts.text: Built a local GUI qualification runner combining prerequisites, static validation, wrapper tests, renderer builds, Angular/Karma coverage, Playwright execution, artifact preservation and reporting.
The regression fixture orchestrates 28 IP projects across two renderers, producing 56 cells; this is fixture scope rather than evidence of 56 passing live executions.
Tied resumable coverage to source, working-tree, matrix, tool and dependency fingerprints and preserved raw coverage/diagnostics before later invocations clear outputs.
Designed coverage-only operation to label synthetic inputs, retain failures and remain explicitly non-qualifying when evidence is incomplete.
The suite records 21 test definitions, including interruption, evidence preservation, fingerprint invalidation and prohibited-command checks; the analysis did not execute them.

Made qualification depend on complete gate/cell/report evidence, raw coverage retention and tracked-tree preservation; interruptions and missing/skipped/synthetic inputs produce a null outcome and an explicit incomplete/interrupted state.

The retained September 21 coverage summary is INTERRUPTED with null outcome, 56 planned cells, 15 failed/40 pending/1 running and qualification_eligible=false; its manifest still says RUNNING. The discrepancy is preserved and does not establish completed matrix qualification or a coverage percentage.

notes: Local-only workflow explicitly rejects cluster execution surfaces. No measured coverage percentage is established.
